# jumpcloud_application_logo (Resource)

Uploads the logo shown for an application in the admin console and the user portal. Works for any application type. Destroying it puts back the template's default icon.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_application_logo" "grafana" {
  application_id = jumpcloud_oidc_application.grafana.id
  file           = "${path.module}/grafana.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application.
- `file` (String) Path to a PNG or JPEG file, such as `"${path.module}/logo.png"`. The logo is uploaded again when the file's content changes. JumpCloud shows it in a square tile, so use a square image.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `application_id`.
- `sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the uploaded file, used to detect changes.
- `url` (String) URL JumpCloud serves the logo from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by application ID. The next apply uploads the configured file once, because
# the logo already in JumpCloud cannot be compared with it.
terraform import jumpcloud_application_logo.grafana 6ac6b310f1aac9c461f1da73
```
